text: Brent closed at 92.94 USD/bbl on 17 November, essentially flat against 92.90 USD/bbl the previous day, and up 3.1% over the week but down 22.1% over the month. In Egypt, the bid deadline for the 14-block EGAS and EGPC rounds was extended to 14 December 2026 on 1 November. Separately, Genel Energy agreed on 28 September to buy Capricorn Energy's Western Desert interests for USD 436 mn.
